verdict.rationale: Vercel's git-push preview deployments (vercel-docs-1, vercel-gh-1) enable every branch/PR to get its own isolated environment, supporting parallel team shipping, and comment/collaboration features (vercel-docs-8) support team workflows. However, there's no explicit evidence of 'unlimited' environments as a guaranteed capability, and community feedback raises cost concerns (vercel-comm-12) and enterprise-gating of security features (vercel-comm-11) that complicate scaling this to a full team at low friction.
